rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy (Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C)
rules.requirement: Prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices (software using algorithms to analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents for vacant units) to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco. Tenants or the City Attorney may bring a civil action for violations.
rules.coverage_text: Residential units in San Francisco; the text states no unit-count or age limits.
rules.penalty: Civil action may be brought by a tenant or the City Attorney.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of such algorithmic devices and allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law.
